main.description: A weekly streaming schedule, rendered as a grid.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name in which slot times are expressed, e.g. 'America/New_York'.

startTime.description: Start time in 24-hour HH:MM format, in the schedule's timezone.

endTime.description: Optional end time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Slots with no endTime are treated as open-ended.

title.description: Optional label for this slot, e.g. 'IRL walks' or 'Subathon'.
